resources.name: ZOV crystal structure (Zn2(OH)VO4)

access.notes: Structure can be generated from reported orthorhombic Pnma lattice parameters a=14.68 Å, b=5.98 Å, c=8.87 Å (JCPDS #89-0171), or obtained from crystallographic databases (e.g., ICSD).

resources.notes: Initial bulk structure for DFT input; the Zn3(OH)VO4 end-state can be built by inserting Zn into the Zn0 and Zn1 sites.

resources.name: DFT software with NEB capability

access.notes: Quantum ESPRESSO or any other open-source DFT code that supports CI-NEB. The paper used VASP, but an open-source equivalent is acceptable.

resources.notes: The agent must install a DFT package and standard GGA-PBE pseudopotentials for Zn, O, V, H.

access.notes: Standard pseudopotentials available from QE website (e.g., SSSP) or similar repositories.
